==Promotion Playoff== The Promotion Playoff was played by the teams placed 1st and 2nd of each zone. The winning team was declared champion and was automatically promoted to [[1999–2000 Argentine Primera División|Primera División]]. The teams that lost in semifinal joined into the Round of 16 of the [[1998–99 Primera B Nacional#Second Promotion Playoff|Second Promotion Playoff]], and the team that lost in the final joined in the Quarterfinals of the [[1998–99 Primera B Nacional#Second Promotion Playoff|Second Promotion Playoff]]. ===Semifinals=== {{TwoLeg start}} |- !colspan="5"|Semifinals {{TwoLegResult|'''[[Instituto Atlético Central Córdoba|Instituto]]'''1||2-2|[[Arsenal de Sarandí|Arsenal]]||1-1|1-1}} |- !colspan="5"|Semifinals {{TwoLegResult|'''[[Chacarita Juniors]]'''1||2–2 |[[Atlético Tucumán]]||0-1|2-1}} {{end}} 1: ''Qualified because of sport advantage''. ===Final=== ==== Match details ==== {{Football box |id = |date = 12 June 1999 |time = |event = Championship playoff |round = First leg |team1 = [[Instituto Atlético Central Córdoba|Instituto (C)]] |score1 = 3 |team2 = [[Chacarita Juniors]] |score2 = 0 |scorenote = |aet = |report = |goals1 = Jiménez {{goal}}{{goal}}
